about: The epistola of the formulary “22nd Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Brethren: We trust in the Lord Jesus that He who began a good work in you will perfect it until the day of Christ Jesus. It is right for me to think this of all of you, because I hold you in my heart, and in my chains as well as in the defense and confirmation of the Gospel you are all partners in my joy. For God is my witness how I long for all of you with the affection of Jesus Christ. And this I pray: that your charity may abound more and more in knowledge and in all understanding, so that you may approve what is better, and be sincere and without offense until the day of Christ, filled with the fruit of justice through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
